messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: API Gateway (ingress-edge) 502/504 error rate spike detected in us-east-1. 5m error rate = 18% (baseline 0.4%). Spike start ~00:18 UTC. Top downstream: /v1/generate and /v1/chat/completions. Correlated with increased connection resets to upstream pool.

sre-alex: on it. paging on-call now. tagging @sre-rachel in case we need overlap.

eng-maya: any recent deploys to edge or control-plane?

platform-ron: no control-plane deploys last 40m. Autoscaler did spin extra workers briefly but errors continued. Metrics show request queue depth shot up on edge-proxy before 502s.

ops-jordan: seeing a large burst of retries from partner-integrations cluster (ip range 35.196.*).* Might be health-check flood or a buggy client backoff.

support-lina: support queue spiking. ~120 customer sessions failing with 502 since the start. Most are ingestion/callback flows to hosted models. We have 12 active tickets opened by customers.

eng-maya: can we validate whether upstream model pods are healthy? any OOMs or connection pool exhaustion?

platform-ron: grabbing upstream pod logs. initial look: many "TLS handshake timeout" and "dial tcp: connection reset by peer" from our edge -> runtime pool. No pod OOMs visible.

sre-alex: mitigation plan proposal: 1) briefly toggle ingress route weight to fallback cluster (lower capacity but more stable) 2) enable heavier rate-limiting for partner-integrations prefix 3) temporarily increase proxy upstream timeout to 20s 4) disable canary routing. agree?

pm-tereza: notify customers in impacted list + add status page entry. If we flip routing, mention degraded throughput.

ops-jordan: prepared rate-limit rule. snippet:```yaml
- match: "/partner/*"
  limit: 100rps
  burst: 50
```

eng-maya: I can flip route weights and rollback canary. executing step 1 now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: Canary rollback triggered by eng-maya at 00:28 UTC. CI/CD job #5012 started.

eng-maya: route weight to fallback cluster set to 80% fallback / 20% primary. watching.

sre-alex: increasing edge proxy timeout from 8s -> 20s (will update envoy config).

platform-ron: envoy config push initiated. validation passed.

ops-jordan: applied rate-limit to partner prefix.

(1m later)

eng-maya: error rate dropped to 4.6% 2m after routing change. latency up ~120ms but stable.

support-lina: customer tickets still trickling but many reports show recovery. posting update in support channel.

pm-tereza: status page updated: "Degraded - elevated errors for API gateway in us-east-1. Mitigations in progress."

sre-alex: root-cause hypotheses: sudden retry storm from partner + edge -> upstream connection resets leading to downstream 502/504. Follow-ups: a) request/backoff policy with partner, b) tune connection pool behavior c) add circuit-breaker for noisy clients.

eng-maya: I'm collecting pprof traces and connection metrics from edge proxies and runtime clients, will attach to incident doc.

sre-rachel: taking over on-call at 00:45 UTC. handing off to me in 15m. I'll continue monitoring till stabilized.

sre-alex: thanks. ops-jordan, please coordinate with partner network team to reduce their health-check frequency. support-lina, keep customer comms every 15m.

ops-jordan: pinged partner infra with logs and suggested backoff. they acknowledged and are throttling their flusher.

(30m later)

eng-maya: fully rolled back canary and rebalanced weights back to 95% primary, 5% fallback after partner throttling confirmed. error rate steady at 0.6%.

support-lina: closing 90% of tickets as recovered, leaving 3 for follow-up.

pm-tereza: preparing post-incident note, will include timeline, mitigations, customer impact, and next steps.

sre-rachel: incident declared resolved at 01:12 UTC. assigning follow-ups: connection-pool hardening (eng), partner traffic throttling policy (partner & ops), alert tuning to suppress noisy retries (sre).

incident-bot: INCIDENT: RESOLVED — API Gateway 5xx spike (us-east-1). Trigger: 5m error rate threshold. Duration: ~54m.

sre-rachel: thanks everyone. will create the incident doc and link to runbook, plus schedule a short RCA sync tomorrow. :thumbsup:
